objective: Determine whether the after-cost high-confidence regions visible in the frozen MNQ short-opportunity aggregate grid persist across calendar time rather than being carried by a small number of regimes, without selecting or tuning a threshold from the aggregate result.
required_evidence_per_cell: aggregate signal count, gross points, net points, and net points per selected signal
calendar-year signal count, net points, and net points per selected signal for every observed year
supported full-year count and positive supported full-year count
share of positive aggregate net points contributed by the single strongest full year when aggregate net is positive
partial 2019 and 2026 evidence reported separately and excluded from the stability gate

cell_classification.TEMPORALLY_ROBUST: aggregate net points per selected signal > 0, at least 5 of 6 full years meet minimum support, at least 4 supported full years have positive net points per selected signal, and no single full year contributes more than 60% of the sum of positive full-year net points
cell_classification.TEMPORALLY_CONCENTRATED: aggregate net points per selected signal > 0 but TEMPORALLY_ROBUST is not satisfied
cell_classification.ECONOMICALLY_NEGATIVE: aggregate net points per selected signal <= 0
cell_classification.INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT: fewer than 5 full years meet the frozen minimum signal support

family_interpretation: A challenger family may be described as having temporal specialist evidence only if at least one predeclared threshold cell is TEMPORALLY_ROBUST at both 1.0 and 2.0 point costs. This does not select that threshold or authorize a policy. Any fixed threshold policy requires a later separately frozen validation on fresh OOS or paper-forward evidence.
forbidden: changing model families, features, target, horizon, retrain cadence, or probability stream
selecting a best threshold from this diagnostic
short execution, StrategySpec mutation, sizing, broker action, model promotion, or live-trading authority
